b2-26-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Toward One Another
b2-26-01.scenario: In the courtyard, Köves Gyuri asks you what the people in the camp still felt for each other.
b2-26-01.prompt: Tell Gyuri what the people still felt for each other.
cues: Say what the people still felt
b2-26-01.target: Akkor is felelősséget éreztünk egymás iránt.
b2-26-01.english: Even then we felt responsible for each other.
b2-26-01.canDo: I can express reciprocal sentiments and attitudes using egymás iránt

b2-26-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Sharing the Costs
b2-26-02.scenario: Steiner úr asks you how the repair costs of the building were shared among the families.
b2-26-02.prompt: Tell Steiner úr how the costs were shared.
b2-26-02.english: The costs were shared out family by family.
b2-26-02.canDo: I can form distributive adverbs with -onként/-enként/-önként from nouns (csoportonként, nemzetiségenként)

b2-26-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Cultural Autonomy
b2-26-03.scenario: Steiner úr asks you what cultural autonomy means for national minorities.
b2-26-03.prompt: Explain to Steiner úr what cultural autonomy is.
b2-26-03.target: A kulturális autonómia a nemzetiségek joga.
b2-26-03.english: Cultural autonomy is the right of the nationalities.
b2-26-03.canDo: I can name the main ideas of minority self-government: kulturális autonómia, nemzetiség, önkormányzatiság

b2-26-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Remembering
b2-26-04.scenario: Steiner úr says people should forget. He asks you what historical memory needs.
b2-26-04.prompt: Tell Steiner úr what historical memory needs.
b2-26-04.target: A túlélők tanúságtétele nélkül hiányos a történelmi emlékezet.
b2-26-04.english: Without the survivors' testimony, historical memory is incomplete.
b2-26-04.canDo: I can name the key ideas of remembrance: tanúságtétel, emberi méltóság, történelmi emlékezet

b2-26-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Talking to Each Other
b2-26-05.scenario: Köves Gyuri and Steiner úr disagree. Gyuri asks you how they can understand each other.
b2-26-05.target: Az őszinte párbeszéd lebontja az előítéleteket.
b2-26-05.canDo: I can name key words of dialogue between communities: párbeszéd, előítélet, közvetítés

b2-26-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What We Owe Each Other
b2-26-consolidation.scenario: At the end of the afternoon, Köves Gyuri asks you what he and Steiner úr owe each other.
b2-26-consolidation.prompt: Tell Gyuri what the two of them need.
cues: Say what they should feel toward each other
b2-26-consolidation.target: Szolidaritást kell éreznünk egymás iránt, és őszinte párbeszédre van szükségünk.
b2-26-consolidation.english: We must feel solidarity toward one another, and we need sincere dialogue.
b2-26-consolidation.canDo: I can use egymás iránt, egymással szemben and egymás mellett in short sentences
